text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the Shuka Sho, I somehow managed
to persuade her to stay, but—

text_block_list.name: Pandora's LANE
text_block_list.text:
"I'm taking a break from training today-mouse.
Squeak, squeak~"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora's motivation
had plummeted drastically!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I only managed to forcibly hold them back;
it hasn't solved the root problem.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How to turn the scenery of her dreams
into reality.
I still had no concrete plan for that... yet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: First, I had to find a way to dispel her anxiety. Days went by reading sports psychology books and consulting with fellow Trainers—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Then, one day.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hey, I did my warmups, can I go home now?
Taaaaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A single streak of wind blew past.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Eh?
What was that just now? I mean—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora's round eyes were glued in place,
not moving an inch. Following her gaze—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: An Umamusume whose sheer talent had Trainers buzzing with rumors, despite not having even debuted yet—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa, haa!
—I'm not done, the real race starts now...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Alright! ...Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Racing across the turf
with the swift, graceful speed of a sudden gust.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A wide range of motion and remarkably nimble footwork.
Both power and instantaneous agility are impeccable—
One glance is all it takes to know she's something special.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora held her breath,
watching her run intently.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Hair and tail fluttering in the wind.
Charging through, picking up speed faster and faster—)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(It was sparkling. It was shining brightly.
It was the best in the world, right at the center of the world.)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"XXXX! XXXX!
XX Eye! XXmond Eye!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye! Almond Eye!
Almond Eye! Almond Eye!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(—Defying all common sense...
The queen... of a new era...!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (Almond Eye!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Holy shiiiit!!!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, hey, hey, isn't this insane!?
It's so amazing, way too amazing, ridiculously amazing, right!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: She's a total genius!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From that day on, Fusaichi Pandora's life
became entirely centered around Almond Eye.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so a-mazing, ouch♡
Wait, isn't that crazy? Can anyone really run that fast?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
She hasn't even debuted yet, right!?
Isn't she an absolute genius!? Like... seriously, an actual genius!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, you're so good at the front crawl!
Your swimming form is totally on point too♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
You're still going~!? Hang in there!
Hang in there! Go for it! Go for it! ♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"And you're up doing it this early, too!?
You're, like, way too impressive!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Ai-chan is
seriously so—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Seriously—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ain't you seriously running way too much?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*, *gasp*――

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Umm...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank goodness! The infirmary wasn't open!
I was just about to call my trainer!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...You were in the middle of training too, weren't you?
I'm sorry for troubling you.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No. Wait... are you okay!?
Want some tea? Or juice?
We should head back to your room, right? Want a piggyback ride?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: No, that won't be necessary.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Besides, my training isn't finished yet.
I can't just go home.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wha-wha-what are you saying!?
There's no point if you collapse again!
Anyway, no running right now, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...I must have really made you worry.
I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no...! Ai-chan is
ten billion times more amazing... than me.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (Lately, I've been... slacking off and completely unmotivated. Compared to before, it's pathetic. I'm sorry, Trainer.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, don't worry anymore!
I was able to recover by resting. Well then—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Go to bed early today! And no training
tomorrow morning either, got it?! Good night!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Whew, I'm exhausted.
Jeez, Ai-chan, honestly~...!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Like, shouldn't that be pretty obvious?
Knowing your limits, I mean, seriously.
What are you doing when you're supposed to be a little genius?)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(...Hm? Ah, right.
Ai-chan is—)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (A genius, sure... but not perfect.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Is that so—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh?
Something you want Pandora-san to do?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Yup♡ Training or anything else, isn't there something I could help you with?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed. I am well aware of Pandora-san's skill
from the recent Twinkle Series races."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why I was wondering...
Would you run in the race seriously?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah... but... Ai-chan.
For me, that really was my best—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No.
If it's you, I know you can reach even greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...I've been studying thousands of Umamusume races lately.
And that's precisely why I know: you can still become much, much faster.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: No... way――

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It's true.
So show it to me with your own two eyes!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ......The eyes—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Ai-chan's round eyes were
sparkling as she looked right at me—so...)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(And then, inside my head, something...
something just snapped—)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (I heard a click as something shifted.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Yep.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ancestor?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
If you're gonna say something like that...!?
Then maybe I'll really give it my all~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
You wanna learn from my race, right?
Leave it to me, no problem, gotcha covered♡
For now, I'm gonna blow everyone away at the next Queen Elizabeth II Cup!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: And with that, see ya☆

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to learn... or rather, what I meant was
that I wanted to race you once you'd grown even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Well, I suppose that's fine.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry, Trainer!
I'm gonna do it after all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One morning, as I was racking my brain
over Fusaichi Pandora's future,
she came bursting in. And then—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I still want to give it my all!
I told you, I still want to keep trying—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I just found a reason!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
And that means it's time for training!
I'm heading out aheeead~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without really understanding what was going on,
I ran after Fusaichi Pandora
as she dashed out onto the grounds.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In an unexpected turn of events, we ended up heading toward the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.
